question: According to the National Sample Survey Office (NSSO), the unemployment rate for individuals aged 15 years and above in urban areas decreased to ________ during January-March 2023 from 8.2 percent a year ago.
solution:
The correct answer is __**6.8**__%.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The unemployment rate for people aged 15 years and above in urban areas **fell to 6.8%.**
 
• **The Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR), **of the population aged 15 years and above,** increased to 48.5% **in January-March 2023.
 
• **The Worker Population Ratio (WPR),** defined as the percentage of employed individuals in the population aged 15 years and above,** rose to 45.2%.**
 
• The data was collected as part of the **Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS)**, which is conducted by the NSSO.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **unemployment rate among males in urban areas decreased to 6.0%** in January-March 2023 from 7.7% a year ago.
 
• The** unemployment rate among females in urban areas dropped to 9.2% **during the same period, down from 10.1% in January-March 2022.
 
• The **Work Participation Rate (WPR) **is defined as the percentage of workers in the total population.in **2011 was 39.8%**.
 
• **Main Workers** constituted 30.4% of the population.
 
• **Marginal Workers** constituted 9.4% of the population.
 
• **In rural areas, the WPR was 41.8%**, with a higher proportion of workers involved in agriculture and related activities.
 
• **In urban areas, the WPR was 35.3%,** with more people involved in non-agricultural sectors like services, trade, and manufacturing.
 
• **Non-workers **(those not engaged in any economically productive activity) accounted for approximately **60.2% of the population.**
